name: GA Cubers Park Be Quiet 2026
information: This competition has **only** Blindfolded and Fewest Moves events and is not suitable for most first-time competitors. If you are interested in competing in regular speedsolving events, you may want to look into [Clocking in Cobb 2026](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockinginCobb2026) two weeks before or one of the Atlanta-area weeknight competitions taking place throughout the fall. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)
